VISIBLE_SECTIONS:
*   **Feature/Value Cards (Top):** Four white cards with rounded corners on an off-white (#FAFBFC) background. No visible topographic/contour-line SVG motif in this specific crop.
*   **Disclaimer Text (Middle):** A block of small, dark gray body text on the off-white background, positioned between the cards and the FAQ section.
*   **FAQ Section (Bottom):** An "FAQ" eyebrow label followed by a large serif heading ("Straight answers to the obvious questions"), introductory body text, and a vertical stack of white accordion cards. The background remains off-white (#FAFBFC). No visible topographic/contour-line SVG motif.

HEADINGS_OCR:
*   "...teams evaluate many possibilities" (Partial heading, top card)
*   "Relevant evidence is fragmented"
*   "Organizing evidence earlier focuses diligence"
*   "Surface the questions sooner"
*   "FAQ" (Eyebrow label)
*   "Straight answers to the obvious questions"
*   "Is Geospatial Labs an engineering firm?"
*   "Does a site screen guarantee interconnection capacity or project feasibility?"
*   "Where does the information come from?"
*   "What happens when information is missing or sources disagree?"
*   "What does a site screen cost..." (Clipped at bottom)

SERIF_CHECK: **SERIF (Newsreader)**. The main FAQ heading "Straight answers to the obvious questions" clearly shows distinct serifs (the "feet" on the 'S', 't', 'a', etc.), providing the requested editorial gravitas. The card headings also appear to be in a bold serif or a very sturdy geometric sans that mimics the weight, but the primary section header is definitively serif.

EMERALD_ACCENT: Emerald green is used for the **icons** inside each of the top four feature cards (stacked layers, location pin, funnel, target/bullseye). It is also used for the **small horizontal line** preceding the "FAQ" eyebrow label. The usage feels **premium and restrained**, matching the B2B editorial brief perfectly. It is not neon or garish.

DEFECTS: 
*   **Clipping at Top Edge:** The first card's heading is cut off horizontally at the very top of the image ("...teams evaluate...").
*   **Clipping at Bottom Edge:** The final FAQ accordion item ("What does a site screen cost...") is cut off vertically at the bottom of the tile.

HERO_REPORT_PREVIEW: Not applicable (Hero section not visible in this tile).

TRUSTBAR_EYEBROW: Not applicable (Trust bar not visible in this tile).

SCORE_THIS_TILE: **9/10**
The design execution is excellent. It strictly follows the premium B2B editorial brief with perfect typography pairing (Serif headings/Sans-serif body), restrained emerald accents, and a clean, high-whitespace layout. Points deducted only for the inevitable edge-clipping inherent in this being a middle-slice of a taller screenshot.

NOTES: The transition from the feature cards to the FAQ section is handled with a simple text disclaimer, which adds a layer of transparency/honesty typical of high-end professional services. The accordion UI in the FAQ section uses clean, minimal chevron icons.
